Since then, Kiseki started coming over to hang out in the Trainer's Office.
Along with her visits, dozens of manga volumes she brought over ended up filling my bookshelf.

However, the gap in their abilities was plain as day.
No matter how undaunted she was, she would likely just taste the same defeat as yesterday.

There it is, Kiseki's weaving run! Darting left and right, she's
bewildering the runners behind her... Wait, and she gets passed with ease――!
Without any wasted motion! I'll! Blow! Past! Yoooouuuuu――!

Next time, please come watch the "main feature."
............I'm running in a mock race the day after tomorrow.

Even when I pulled off that massive comeback as the relay anchor, all I could think was:
'Doesn't this make me look totally like a manga protagonist?!'...!

――Ghh, Trainer! Races are incredible!
They captivate the audience, shock them, and move them to tears! It's――
Ugh, give it a rest! Just give up already!
In a world of 60 km/h, I draw.

Seeing her boundless momentum, the source of her colorful and distinct running styles became clear.
In other words, she was――

Since when?! How?!
And from that position――

Yes, thank you for your hard work!
――Wait, ah, you're...! The one who's always here...!

Marking me is useless, Kiseki-san!
That yakisoba pan is mine!

I want to become the protagonist of the story!
I want to win the race... and shine as the champion!

Chills ran down my spine. That was a stunning turnaround that completely overturned defeat.
...Before I knew it, I was applauding from afar.

To create a hit, one must master the classics!
I can run from the front too, you knowww――!

Yet the other Umamusume shifted into a higher gear as well.
It seemed she refused to yield when it came to culinary joys. Once again, they pulled level, and then...

...I'm always aiming for a run that's thrilling.
Just like how you got excited watching me.

Yaaaaaaahhhhh!
Haaaaaaahhhhh!

It was lunchtime, when Umamusume rushed toward the school store all at once.
That was when a pair of footsteps, louder than all the rest, echoed through the hall.

I can do things just like in manga! I can captivate everyone, and create a race as flashy,
thrilling, and passionate as a legendary manga series with my own two legs!

Her run gained momentum alongside her bizarre battle cries. While a bit overstrained...
Her powerful, spirited stride accelerated step by step.

That's why reading it makes you want to cheer! Please let their hard work pay off!
You pray as you turn to the next page... and bam, a double-page turnaround spread! Ahh, it gets me so fired up!

――――............! L-Like――...!
That means you're interested in me, right...?!

There's a manga I want you to see.
Because I'm sure... you'll love it.
H-Huh?! No waaaaay――?!
Everyone else is bound to be thrilled too...!!

No! This Kiseki will never accept getting 'cancelled' by a loss!
Ora-ora-ora-ora-ora-ora-oraaaaahhhhh――!

I'll take the inside, Senpai!
My one remaining key to turning this around lies on the curve ahead...!

Yep, any genre works! Whenever I find the seeds of a story around me,
I cultivate them into full bloom in my own way!
It's a manga starring 'future me' as the protagonist.

...Yes, that's what I thought at the time. That she was just stubbornly
flailing about because she refused to give up. A common story among Umamusume at the academy――

...If you give up, it's over! The protagonist never gives up!!
And that's what makes a story...――interesting!!

Kiseki hands me the tablet she was holding.
Displayed upon it was a manga that...
★――Next issue: Kiseki sprints ahead! Carve out soul-stirring hoofprints!!

"Lunch break started!" "Only 10 Deluxe Yakisoba Pans in stock today!"
"That's so few?! Gotta hurry!!"

And so, I wanted to draw wonderful manga like that too!
Using the tablet I got for my birthday, I draw manga every single day!!

Like the night I dashed back to grab something I forgot. Or the day I slipped through
the door one minute before closing. Or the moment I won rock-paper-scissors for seconds!

What decided the outcome was the difference in top speed.
Although the Umamusume named Kiseki ultimately suffered defeat...

Descend upon me, inspiration. Blow everything away with sheer excitement.
I'll show them. The one and only story born from these legs.

She aimed for the shortest line. Her opponent drifted wide and lost rhythm.
...In an instant, she had completely overturned the match.

There was no reason to decline Kiseki's invitation.
Two days later, I headed to the track. Awaiting there――
...was a hurdle far too high for Kiseki to clear.

Undaunted by defeat, she devised a surprising breakthrough and seized victory.
Her run felt like a complete masterpiece of its own. ...From tomorrow onward, she will surely――
――...This is my "story."

All right! Complete, total, victory!
............Heheh...!

She had plenty of room to grow. I hoped she would hone her legs and try again――
Such were the ordinary expectations I held as a trainer at the academy.
――Now is the time: "No one passes me"!

It was the season when the leaves began to change.
One day amidst a stretch of crisp, clear autumn weather.

Ahhh, what an expression! Add white outlines to make it pop!
Nnngh, this is so good! A plot twist like this... ghh!!

And so, whenever lunchtime arrived, I found myself heading to the school store.
Sometimes laughing, sometimes holding my head, sometimes cheering her on... straight from the heart.

Waaah! Even if I missed the start, I gotta go for it!
"Full-Throttle Dash"! Hang in there, meee!

Allow me to explain! I am Kiseki, an Umamusume who absolutely loves manga
and wants to run in hot-blooded, exciting races just like them!

Here it comes—Kiseki's Wall-Kick Shortcut!
............Hyaaaah!!

Oooooh! Surge, my vitality! Burn, my blood—unleash it all for my dearest wish!
Special Move... "Blazing Soul"!!

Manga sets people's hearts ablaze! Why? Because it has everything!
Encounters and farewells, victory and defeat, discovery and despair... All that conflicting drama!

The more I watched her, the more my interest grew tenfold.
Eventually, my feet moved on their own, wanting to reach out to her as a trainer—
—And so, Trainer!!
...It happened the very next day.
